caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object that appears to be a three-paneled window or mirror, oriented horizontally within the composition. The object is framed by a detailed border made up of vertically and horizontally oriented baluster-like supports, rendered in shades of golden yellow and brown to suggest wood or a similar material. Each corner of the frame is marked by a small square containing a carved or ornamental design, while the vertical and horizontal sections of the frame feature turned, spindle-like elements. The interior of the frame is divided into three vertical panels, each filled with a light blue color that has subtle gradient shading and white vertical streaks, suggesting a reflective or translucent surface. The background is an off-white color, and there is a signature "Stewart" in small brown letters near the lower right of the framed object. There are no other objects or details in the composition.
title: Gilt Mirror
